decision_basis.athlete_direction: Return fork HSC one click softer to the 2026-07-28 setting for a chill Stumpjumper ride after Thursday's attack-setting validation.
decision_basis.density: This would be the third MTB exposure in four days after Tuesday's load-218/RPE-10 session. It is permitted only as a genuinely low-cost skill/compliance touch.
decision_basis.interpretation_limit: Friday is not a counterbalanced HSC performance comparison because Thursday fatigue and day-order effects remain; it tests whether the softer setting still provides calm small-hit compliance at chill speed.

session.title: Stumpjumper HSC softer-setting chill compliance ride
session.purpose: Use a short, low-consequence Stumpjumper touch to confirm that the 2026-07-28 HSC setting remains a calm compliance option for chill riding without turning Friday into a second setup or intensity session.

dose.precondition: Thursday must finish within its duration, load, RPE, and technical contract with no unintended steering or triggered stop rule; Friday physical/CNS readiness and subjective clarity must remain clean.
dose.setup: Return fork HSC exactly one click softer to the 2026-07-28 setting before riding. Leave every other variable unchanged.
dose.ride: Forty-five to sixty minutes total. Use easy access riding and at most one familiar low-consequence 2K descent at approximately 65-75 percent, then exit.
dose.climbs: RPE 2-3, seated or naturally standing only where terrain requires; no torque target.
dose.hard_cap: One descent and 60 minutes. No 2K+, Pure Quill, Twin Peaks repeat, speed chase, jumps, or additional setup change.

session.adaptation_hypothesis: The softer HSC setting should preserve small-hit compliance and calm chill-speed tracking while Friday's low dose supports bike continuity without adding meaningful high-aerobic or neural debt.
execution_rules: Treat this as recovery skill, not an A/B verdict against Thursday's attack setting.
Use familiar lines, early braking, wide vision, dynamically centred posture, and no deliberate large-hit attack.
Keep tyre pressure, rebound, shock, cockpit, and cleats unchanged.
Fuel normally; for a ride approaching 60 minutes in Kuala Lumpur heat, bring fluid and enough sodium for actual sweat conditions.

expected_result.technical: Small-hit tracking remains calm and intentional with no left pull, front ping, rearward retreat, wallow, or correction.
expected_result.physiology: Whole-session RPE 2-4 with stable or improving legs and no meaningful high-intensity accumulation.
expected_result.week: Saturday church commitment and Sunday Sabbath remain fully protected.

stop_rules: Skip Friday for red readiness, impaired/compromised CNS status, poor sleep response, unusual soreness/fatigue, or any unresolved bike concern.
Skip Friday if Thursday exceeds RPE 7, load 175, the written duration cap, or produces any unintended steering, deflection, near miss, late skill fade, or triggered stop rule.
Any leftward steering tendency, unexpected front behaviour, reactive braking, or worsening legs ends the ride via the safest easy exit.
Do not upgrade the chill ride because the bike feels good.
